cards.title: Kinetically constrained spin-s Hamiltonian
cards.role: Defines the exact sparse and blocked-MPS quantum dynamics and the level-statistics operator.
cards.numerical_form: Enumerate periodic configurations with no adjacent nonzero occupations for exact diagonalization, or pair physical sites into the exact constrained block basis |00>,|01>,|10> for paper-scale MPS evolution; apply the spin flip only when both neighbours are zero.

checks.evidence: paper-source/Quantum_ManybodyScar_Main_v16_arxiv.tex:316-337
The n-to-n+1 and reverse matrix elements are identical real numbers.

cards.title: Normalized projected coherent-state MPS
cards.role: Provides a source-independent way to evaluate the variational state and tangent vectors.
cards.numerical_form: For occupation n, use amplitude (-i)^n sqrt(C(2s,n)) cos(theta/2)^(2s-n) sin(theta/2)^n in the 2x2 physical MPS matrix and normalize the finite ring explicitly.

checks.evidence: Supplement I, MPS representation and Norm subsections
At theta_i=0 the trace product has the sole amplitude |00...0> with unit norm.

cards.title: Two-site TDVP flow
cards.role: Generates the phase portraits and undeformed periodic orbits.
cards.numerical_form: Evaluate paired odd/even RHS with Omega=1; split integration at coordinate singularities rather than changing the physical state.

checks.evidence: paper-source/Quantum_ManybodyScar_Main_v16_arxiv.tex:451-461 and supplement:711-734
At (theta_e,theta_o)=(pi,0), dot(theta_e)=Omega and the transverse component vanishes in the regular chart.

cards.title: Intensive TDVP leakage
cards.role: Quantifies how rapidly exact motion leaves the variational manifold.
source_refs: Supplement Eq. (S error) and Error calculation
cards.numerical_form: Construct normalized finite-ring MPS and analytic tangent vectors, apply the independently built constrained Hamiltonian, and take the Euclidean residual norm divided by sqrt(L).

checks.evidence: main lines 470-482 and supplement lines 440-458
At the Neel product point H|psi> is exactly the collective tangent in the regular chart, so gamma tends to zero.

cards.title: Adjacent-gap ratio
cards.role: Tests the crossover from Poisson to GOE level statistics.
cards.numerical_form: Diagonalize the k=0, inversion-even block, sort energies, remove only machine-zero gaps, and average adjacent ratios.

checks.evidence: main Fig. 2 caption
Every ratio lies in [0,1]; reference ensemble means are approximately 0.386 and 0.536.

open_questions: The exact L list used for each spin in Fig. 2(a) is not printed.

cards.title: Subsystem entanglement entropy
cards.role: Generates Fig. 2(b,c) from independently evolved periodic L=30 state amplitudes.
cards.numerical_form: For reduced exact evidence, expand translation-orbit coefficients and trace equal environment configurations. For the paper-scale lane, contract the checkpointed blocked MPS to the three-block and one-block reduced density matrices, trace the unobserved spin inside the one-block matrix, and diagonalize both.

checks.evidence: main Fig. 2 caption; Supplement IV explicitly uses log base 2
A product-state amplitude tensor has rank-one rho_A and S_A=0.

cards.title: Constrained infinite-temperature local magnetization
cards.role: Supplies a non-fitted thermalization check for the zero-state quenches.
cards.numerical_form: Evaluate directly for s=1/2,1,2 and compare long-time zero-state averages.

checks.evidence: supplement lines 947-959
Direct substitution gives -0.2236068, -0.5, and -1.05317 for s=1/2,1,2.

cards.title: Deformed constrained Hamiltonian
cards.role: Defines the exact deformed generator used to evaluate Supplement Fig. S2 residuals.
cards.numerical_form: Modify each allowed spin-1/2 flip by the two next-nearest Sz eigenvalues, then independently project the matrix Hamiltonian onto the two MPS tangents.

checks.evidence: Supplement V prints the Hamiltonian immediately before the deformed MPS equations.
The independently constructed matrix Hamiltonian projects to the printed deformed flow within 3.9e-4 at L=12.

open_questions: The generated converged residual does not reproduce the Fig. S2 minimum near h/Omega=0.045, while the supplement omits the closed deformed residual construction and numerical orbit-integral procedure. Protocol-v2 therefore assigns parameter_ambiguity; paper_error_candidate is blocked by paper_exact=false and fresh_independent_review=false.

cards.title: Deformed s=1/2 TDVP flow
cards.role: Generates Figs. S1-S2 for the deformed Hamiltonian.
cards.numerical_form: Use the printed four h/Omega values for S1 and h/Omega=0..0.08 for S2; preserve coordinate-chart jumps.

checks.evidence: supplement lines 963-990
Expanding sec(theta_o/2)[cos^2(theta_o/2)+cos^2(theta_e/2)sin(theta_e/2)sin(theta_o/2)] equals EQ-FLOW for s=1/2.

cards.title: Translation-by-two orbit basis
cards.statement: For an orbit alpha of size p_alpha, |alpha>=p_alpha^{-1/2} sum_{x in alpha}|x>; a transition sum A from one representative alpha to orbit beta gives H_{beta,alpha}=sqrt(p_alpha/p_beta) A.
cards.role: Makes reduced exact product-state dynamics fit in local memory without changing the quantum model.
source_refs: Main Figs. 1b, 2b-c, and 4b,d use two-site-periodic initial states and periodic boundaries
cards.numerical_form: Build exact T^2 orbits, normalized orbit states, and parity-averaged local observables.

checks.evidence: main text states theta_i=theta_{i+2}; all quench states have period one or two
Disjoint product states make every normalized orbit vector unit norm; edge counting makes the reduced Hamiltonian Hermitian.

cards.title: Exact pair blocking and finite-MPS time evolution
cards.statement: In the pair basis |00>,|01>,|10>, H=sum_j[X_right(j) P_left(j+1)+P_right(j) X_left(j+1)]; on the invariant globally constrained subspace the periodic sum is exactly the physical PXP ring, and a symmetric product formula evolves an MPS with controlled time-step and bond-dimension refinements.
cards.role: Provides the scalable paper-scale path for the periodic L=30 six-site and one-site entropies in Main Fig. 2(b,c).
cards.numerical_form: Use 15 three-state blocks, periodic bond gates, max bond dimensions 512/768, time steps 0.025/0.0125, digest-bound checkpoints every 2/Omega, and base-2 reduced-density-matrix entropies through t*Omega=100/120.

checks.evidence: Main Eq. (1) gives the projected spin-flip Hamiltonian and the Main Fig. 2 caption fixes periodic L=30 and the entropy/time ranges.
tests/test_fig2_tdmrg.py compares the blocked periodic Hamiltonian with the independently enumerated physical constrained Hamiltonian to 1e-14.
tests/test_fig2_tdmrg.py compares the symmetric MPS product formula with dense periodic evolution.
tests/test_fig2_tdmrg.py verifies checkpoint/resume and uninterrupted smoke curves agree to 2e-12.
tests/test_fig2_tdmrg.py executes all six smoke shards, merges their digest-matched outputs, and verifies a subsequent resume skips every lane.
The independent forbidden-pair contraction matches dense evaluation below 1e-11; the final L=8 smoke keeps total forbidden-state weight below 4.12e-12.

open_questions: The paper fixes L=30 and the plotted time ranges but does not report its numerical time step, bond dimension, truncation cutoff, or even an explicit tensor-network evolution method; the independent campaign therefore declares and refines all three controls rather than attributing them to the authors.

cards.title: Momentum-zero inversion-even orbit basis
cards.statement: Equal-weight normalized orbits of the dihedral translation/reflection group span the k=0, inversion-even sector used in Fig. 2(a).
cards.role: Implements the explicitly named level-statistics symmetry sector.
cards.numerical_form: Enumerate dihedral orbits, build the exact projected Hamiltonian by orbit edge counting, then diagonalize the reduced dense matrix.

checks.evidence: Fig. 2(a) explicitly specifies momentum zero and inversion symmetry
Equal-weight group averaging projects onto the trivial translation and reflection representation.

open_questions: The paper does not list every system size used in the plotted sequence.
